messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Prolly my last season as I dont have the time now that I just shelled out $1M for this company....need eyes on it.

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: Don't make any proclamations just yet... my post was to mention where we should be. Most guys get there, but rather than waiting till 10 days left, I thought a gentle nudge at the 50% mark was better

messages.author: GaelicGopher
messages.text:
Nick and I will sell you the rights to Segathon, Inc for $2M.  Trust me, it’s a steal.  Significant Upside.

Oh, and we need digital Chicklets “your kid is right behind you” is one of my favorite W moments to date!

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Oh I understand I just know that my time is becoming less and less for anything outside of work and family. And as much as I want to continue to play and hope to continue to play, there is always that chance that I may not but we shall see

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: On that note ... I'll be online this weekend to play....will ping everyone.

messages.author: Pink_Elephants
messages.text: There are guys in this community who would pay @MattyA $1M to trade OV8

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: Step up to the mic and let me know.. that would make the bank a very happy person and it would save me a crap ton of interest lol

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: For all of you that took my last post as a sign that I'm not going to get it done this season, I definitely will for sure. Anyway I'm just worried about my time for future seasons

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: Stick surround. The seasons are 6 months long, your good.

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: Ok not that long but..... don't go..

messages.author: MattyA
messages.text: I am really trying to make sure I play moving forward....that I promise.... As you can see it's 10:30 and I'm just now finishing up for the night

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: I havnt done the math.  But even if u played literally 1 game every 2 days u would still finish on time.

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: Plus most of the leauge are moon lighters anyways.  😆
